Be nice, comment section is to help people. For example, one trick I found if the expansion joint is moving around too much while you try to get the alignment tool on is to hook your allen key around the back side to keep it in place. Worked like a charm.

content: This might be the most annoying part of the build. You need to use the tool for every tightening, otherwise the expansion joints rotate

This was truly horrible. The expansion joins slide off, since it is very easy to knock them out of position with the alignment tool - and because we were instructed to face them outwards, one bump can easily reset the whole tightening process.
